selector.rationale: Annular erythematous plaques with violaceous and crusted centers, and laboratory findings of fever and elevated C-reactive protein, are consistent with Sweet syndrome, which is further supported by the presence of inflammatory infiltrate of predominantly mononuclear cells in superficial and mid dermis and positive immunohistochemistry for myeloperoxidase

rejected.label: Neutrophilic dermatosis
rejected.why: less specific findings and lower score

rejected.label: Leukemic cutis
rejected.why: less specific and similar to leukemia cutis but with lower score

rejected.label: Drug rash
rejected.why: less likely due to the specific skin biopsy findings and low score
